def _cart_position(event, item, membership=None, **kwargs):
    return CartPosition.objects.create(
        item=item, price=23, expires=now() + timedelta(days=1), event=event, cart_id="123",
        used_membership=membership, **kwargs
    )


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_no_membership_required(event, customer, granting_ticket):
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, granting_ticket)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_required_but_missing(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event)
    assert 'requires an active membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_used_but_not_required(event, customer, membership, granting_ticket):
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, granting_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event)
    assert 'does not require a membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event, lock=True, testmode=False)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_other_customer(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    other = event.organizer.customers.create(email="jane@example.org")
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(other, [cp1], event)
    assert 'different customer account' in excinfo.value.message
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(None, [cp1], event)
    assert 'different customer account' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_canceled(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.canceled = True
    membership.save()
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event)
    assert 'has been canceled' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_testmode(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.testmode = True
    membership.save()
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event, testmode=False)
    assert 'test mode membership for tickets that are not in test mode' in excinfo.value.message
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event, testmode=True)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_testmode_needs_testmode_membership(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event, testmode=True)
    assert 'add a test mode membership' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_type_not_allowed(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket, membership_type):
    other_type = event.organizer.membership_types.create(name="Half pass")
    requiring_ticket.require_membership_types.set([other_type])
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event)
    assert 'which is not allowed for the product' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_expired(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.date_start -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.date_end -= timedelta(days=100)
    membership.save()
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event)
    assert 'but selected an event taking place' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_valid_from_not_chosen(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp1.override_valid_from = datetime(2021, 5, 20, 10, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    cp1.override_valid_until = None
    # Start of the ticket is outside the membership, but not chosen yet, so this is accepted ...
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event, valid_from_not_chosen=True)
    # ... while a chosen start date is checked against the membership
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1], event)
    assert 'starts to be valid on' in excinfo.value.message


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket, membership_type):
    membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership_type.save()
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    order = _create_order(event, email='dummy@example.org', positions=[cp1],
                          now_dt=now(),
                          sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
                          payment_requests=[{
                              "id": "test0",
                              "provider": "banktransfer",
                              "max_value": None,
                              "min_value": None,
                              "multi_use_supported": False,
                              "info_data": {},
                              "pprov": BankTransfer(event),
                              "payment_amount": Decimal("23.00"),
                          }],
                          locale='de', customer=customer)[0]

    cp2 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp2], event)
    assert 'more than 1 times' in excinfo.value.message
    # The order's own usage does not count when the order is changed
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp2], event, ignored_order=order)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_parallel_usage_in_cart(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket, membership_type):
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp2 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)
    assert 'at the same time' in excinfo.value.message

    membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership_type.save()
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_overlapping_ticket_validity(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket, membership_type):
    cp1 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp1.override_valid_from = datetime(2021, 4, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    cp1.override_valid_until = datetime(2021, 4, 5, 23, 59, 59, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    cp2 = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    cp2.override_valid_from = datetime(2021, 4, 4, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    cp2.override_valid_until = datetime(2021, 4, 10, 23, 59, 59, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError) as excinfo:
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)
    assert 'overlaps with this time frame' in excinfo.value.message

    cp2.override_valid_from = datetime(2021, 4, 6, 0, 0, 0, 0, tzinfo=TZ)
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp1, cp2], event)
